SUMMARY SHEET ON THE 1931 SEP 21 EARTHQUAKE (SHEET 2 OF 2)

C. BRIEF DESCRIPTIONS
Hong Kong = 16:30 - Felt

Guangdong Province

Guangzhou 18:28 6 min - Hanging objects swung
- Many frightened and ran outdoors
18:30 4 min - Many frightened and ran outdoors
- 4 houses collapsed
- No injury
Sanshui 16:20 3 min - Hanging objects swung

- Windows rattled

- Unstable objects upset

- Liquids disturbed, some spilled
- No injury

- No buildings collapsed

Zhaoging 16:27 3 min - Felt

Kaiping - Felt
